title: Mount the app and AI inside a Koa server
prompt: We are moving a Koa service to Inferlo step by step. Create src/koa.ts exporting `function createKoaServer(): Koa` (from the koa package). Requests whose path starts with /api must be handled by the Inferlo app from src/app.ts mounted under /api with Inferlo's Koa integration (GET /api/health reaches the app's GET /health route, /api/openapi.json serves its OpenAPI document). Every Koa middleware must have the app's AI client as ctx.ai. Every other request is answered by Koa: status 200 with the plain text body "koa".
